headline: Crescent Energy Beats Earnings Estimates
summary: Crescent Energy reported earnings that beat analyst estimates by $0.16 alongside stronger-than-expected revenue.
why: Earnings reports provide crucial insights into an energy company's profitability, operational efficiency, and cash flow generation amid fluctuating commodity prices.

impacts.name: Crescent Energy Company
impacts.why: Beating consensus earnings and revenue estimates directly reflects positively on the company's financial performance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
